sources.quote: NXTP Philosophy Team Portfolio Buenos Aires Investing in technology founders from Latin America to the world. Rooted in Latin America. Built for the world. Argentina · Brazil · Chile · Colombia · Mexico · Peru · Uruguay · Global Proud to back 280+ pioneering founders. See the full portfolio → Auth0 ↗ Eugenio Pace, Matias Woloski Auth0 is an enterprise identity & authentication platform. Developer-centric and product-led, they exemplify what we find so attractive in B2B SaaS startups. They were acquired by Okta in May 2021 for $6.5bn. We are proud to have been their first check back in 2014. Nuvemshop ↗ Alejandro Alfonso, Alejandro Vazquez, Jose Abuchaem, Martin Palombo, Santiago Sosa Nuvemshop is Latin America's leading e-commerce platform. It currently empowers 85,000+ merchants to launch, develop and promote their own online businesses. A Seed investment from our Fund I, Nuvemshop recently announced a $500m Series E in August 2021, led by Insight Partners and Tiger Global.
